datasets.name: quays_all_versions
datasets.description: Refreshed daily. All historical versions of every Quay in the Norwegian National Stop Registry (NSR). One row per (`id`, `version`); use the parent Stop Place's `validBetween` to determine which version was active at a given time. A Stop Place may contain multiple Quays; join to `stop_places_all_versions` via `stopPlaceRef` + `stopPlaceVersion`. For only the latest version per Quay, see `quays_last_version`.

datasets.name: siri_et_estimated_times
datasets.description: Refreshed daily. Per-stop SIRI-ET estimated arrival/departure times compared against the recorded actuals at fixed lead times before the stop (e.g. the estimate 5 minutes before the actual arrival). Lets you assess the quality of real-time estimates and the journey information available to travellers. Based on Entur's SIRI-ET stream covering multiple Norwegian operators — see developer.entur.org/pages-real-time-intro.

columns.name: operatingDate
columns.description: Date of the vehicle journey. For example: 2020-01-10

columns.name: dataSource
columns.description: Codespace of the data source. For example: AKT (Agder kollektivtrafikk)

columns.name: transportMode
columns.description: Transport mode for the vehicle Journey. For example: BUS

columns.name: lineRef
columns.description: Reference to the line of the vehicle journey. For example: AKT:Line:100

columns.name: serviceJourneyId
columns.description: ID of the service journey. For example: RUT:ServiceJourney:17-154797-20890925

columns.name: datedServiceJourneyId
columns.description: ID of the service journey with date. For example: 2021-09-09:RUT:ServiceJourney:17-154797-20890925

columns.name: stopPointRef
columns.description: Served quay by the vehicle journey in NSR format. For example: NSR:Quay:105273 (Storgata)

columns.name: parentStopPointRef
columns.description: Parent stop point for th equay specified in StopPointRef.

columns.name: stopPointName
columns.description: Name of stop. For example: Storgata

columns.name: sequenceNr
columns.description: Number in the sequence of served stops. For example: 23

columns.name: timeDeltaMinutes
columns.description: Describes how many minutes before the actual arrival/departure the estimated times are taken from. Example: 10

columns.name: AimedArrivalTime
columns.description: Planned arrival time of vehicle at a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:00 UTC

columns.name: arrivalTime
columns.description: Actual arrival time of a vehicle at a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:25:11 UTC

columns.name: estimatedArrivalTime
columns.description: Estimated arrival time of a vehicle at a stop at a certain point in time(timeDelataMinutes before arrivalTime). For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:10 UTC

columns.name: EstimatedArrivalRecordedAtTime
columns.description: Timestamp when estimatedArrivalTime was generated. Closest timestamp larger than arrivaltime - timeDeltaMinutes

columns.name: AimedDepartureTime
columns.description: Planned departure time of a vehicle from a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:00 UTC

columns.name: departureTime
columns.description: Actual departure time of a vehicle from a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:25:11 UTC

columns.name: estimatedDepartureTime
columns.description: Estimated departure time of a vehicle at a stop at a certain point in time(timeDelataMinutes before departureTime). For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:10 UTC

columns.name: EstimatedDepartureRecordedAtTime
columns.description: Timestamp when estimatedDepartureTime was generated. Closest timestamp larger than departuretime - timeDeltaMinutes

datasets.name: realtime_siri_et_last_recorded
datasets.description: Refreshed daily. Recorded SIRI-ET data: the last message of a journey, providing a "trip summary". The most-used fields, with one row per stop in a journey. Covers multiple Norwegian operators from Q1 2020 onward and is updated every morning. Based on Entur's SIRI-ET stream — see developer.entur.org/pages-real-time-intro.

columns.name: recordedAtTime
columns.description: The time when the data object was created/published. For example: 2020-02-13 23:29:54.82 UTC

columns.name: lineRef
columns.description: Reference to the line of the vehicle journey. For example: AKT:Line:100

columns.name: directionRef
columns.description: Reference to the relative direction of the vehicle journey. For example: 2 (Outbound)

columns.name: operatingDate
columns.description: Date of the vehicle journey. For example: 2020-01-10

columns.name: dayOfTheWeek
columns.description: Day of the week. For example: 3 (Wednesday)

columns.name: serviceJourneyId
columns.description: ID of the service journey. For example: RUT:ServiceJourney:17-154797-20890925

columns.name: datedServiceJourneyId
columns.description: ID of the service journey with date. For example: 2021-09-09:RUT:ServiceJourney:17-154797-20890925

columns.name: operatorRef
columns.description: ID to the corresponding company responsible for vehicle journey. For example: nettbuss

columns.name: vehicleMode
columns.description: Transport type. For example: bus

columns.name: extraJourney
columns.description: Boolean indicator of if vehicle journey is a replacement departure. For example: true (vehicle journey is a replacement departure)

columns.name: journeyCancellation
columns.description: Boolean indicator of if vehicle journey is a cancelled departure. For example: true (vehicle journey is a cancelled departure)

columns.name: stopPointRef
columns.description: Served quay by the vehicle journey in NSR format. For example: NSR:Quay:105273 (Storgata)

columns.name: sequenceNr
columns.description: Number in the sequence of served stops. For example: 23

columns.name: stopPointName
columns.description: Name of stop. For example: Storgata

columns.name: originName
columns.description: Name of the first stop of the departure. For example: Skøyen stasjon

columns.name: destinationName
columns.description: Name of the last stop of the vehicle journey. For example: Simensbråten

columns.name: extraCall
columns.description: Boolean indicator of whether the served stop is in addition to the planned stop sequence

columns.name: stopCancellation
columns.description: Boolean indicator for whether a stop is cancelled in this journey. For example: True (Stop is not served on this journey)

columns.name: estimated
columns.description: Boolean indicator of whether the data is estimated

columns.name: aimedArrivalTime
columns.description: Planned arrival time of vehicle at a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:00 UTC

columns.name: arrivalTime
columns.description: Actual arrival time of a vehicle at a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:25:11 UTC

columns.name: aimedDepartureTime
columns.description: Planned departure time of a vehicle from a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:23:00 UTC

columns.name: departureTime
columns.description: Actual departure time of a vehicle from a stop. For example: 2020-02-13 23:25:11 UTC

columns.name: dataSource
columns.description: Codespace of the data source. For example: AKT (Agder kollektivtrafikk)
